p.title: The news count did not say which list it covered, and the concept-map list printed a relation word without a direction
p.symptom: The news strip showed '12건 표시 / 40건 일치' with no word on whether country, topic or type filters applied, and the channel (Telegram) list below it is classified on its own; the note about that was empty when only the Telegram type chip narrowed the articles. The connected-concepts list printed only the relation word (for example '분해') for both outgoing and incoming edges, and the text alternative could print an internal edge type (CAUSES).
p.root_cause: The scope was implicit in the controls and the two lists shared one count; the map aside dropped the edge direction; the text alternative preferred the enum over the Korean relation.
p.fix: describeNewsScope states '필터 적용'/'필터 없음' on the article count and, whenever a control is active, that the channel list ignores the country and topic filters. The connected-concepts list prefixes an arrow for the edge direction and the text alternative shows the edge's own relation, never the type.
p.violated_rule: A count says which list and which filter state it covers.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check P1537 covers every control state of describeNewsScope; ci-knowledge-renderer-contract P1537 renders the text alternative with relation and type and checks the direction wiring.
p.verification: esm-core-unit, architecture and knowledge renderer contract checks pass. Not done: the channel count with a pool total, the glossary-to-indicator link (H109, four atlas-backed terms only and the indicator screens read no metric or timeframe parameter) and the Korean type labels for concept edges (no source for the wording).
